cookie.description: Your LinkedIn session cookie. Accepts either: (1) the li_at value from browser DevTools → Application → Cookies, or (2) full cookies JSON array exported from an extension like EditThisCookie.
cookie.title: LinkedIn Cookie

excludeAuthorTypes.description: Drop comments authored by the selected actor types. PERSON = individual member profiles, COMPANY = company / organization pages.
excludeAuthorTypes.title: Exclude Author Types

includeReplies.description: Whether to fetch replies to top-level comments. Each reply is output as a separate dataset row with isReply=true and parentCommentId linking to the parent.
includeReplies.title: Include Replies

language.description: Preferred LinkedIn UI language. Sets the Accept-Language header and x-li-lang for Voyager API calls; influences which translations LinkedIn returns for comment text.
language.title: Language

maxCommentsPerPost.description: Maximum number of top-level comments to scrape per post.
maxCommentsPerPost.title: Max Comments Per Post

minReactions.description: Skip comments with fewer than this many reactions (likes + other reaction types). 0 disables the filter and emits every comment.
minReactions.title: Minimum Reactions

postUrls.description: LinkedIn post URLs to scrape comments from. Accepts formats like: https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7329761432933134337/ or https://www.linkedin.com/posts/username_some-slug-7329761432933134337/. Use a public, high-engagement post URL for best results. The prefill example uses a Bill Gates post from early 2025.
postUrls.title: Post URLs

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify proxy configuration. Residential proxy recommended for best results.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

replyDepth.description: How many levels deep to recurse when fetching replies. Only honored when Include Replies is enabled. 1 = direct replies only, 2 = replies of replies, 3 = three levels.
replyDepth.title: Reply Depth

sortBy.description: Sort order for comments. RELEVANCE uses LinkedIn's default 'Most relevant'. RECENT shows newest first.
sortBy.title: Sort Comments By
